meta.name: The Apartment Job
meta.description: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Desperate to raise a fortune, Park Hae-kang tries every scheme imaginable. But when he still comes up short, a tip leads him to an apartment complex.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After discovering the apartment's reserve fund, Hae-kang sets out to steal it. But first, he must somehow win the election to join the association.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hae-kang enters a tight and competitive election. While a nosy opponent tries to sway voters, he spots a unique opportunity to win over the residents.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After winning the election, Hae-kang aims for the presidency. But when his gangster past is exposed, a new subway entrance becomes his lifeline.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Having finally reached his goal, Hae-kang prepares to disappear without a trace. But when he heads to the bank to claim the cash, everything unravels.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With Jang Suk-jin on their tail, Hae-kang and Kang Ha-ri scramble to keep their secret safe. Soon, they launch a crusade to find the missing funds.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Lee Chung-won watches Hae-kang's every move, including his push to raise maintenance dues. Ha-ri struggles with the guilt of deceiving her sister.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Conflict erupts between owners and rental tenants after outsiders are caught using the sauna, forcing Hae-kang to find a way to bridge the divide.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Chung-won orders Hae-kang to deliver the ledger, putting Ha-ri's sister in danger. When Hae-kang reveals the truth to Ha-ri, she grapples with betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Police arrest Hae-kang after accusing him of stealing the repair fund. But to get back at Chung-won, Hae-kang returns with a strategic counterattack.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A tragedy drives Hae-kang to take down Chung-won, who moves ahead with his new development. He joins forces with Suk-jin to uncover the embezzled funds.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Despite setbacks, Hae-kang sets his endgame in motion to bring down Chung-won once and for all. Will justice finally come to the apartment complex?

meta.slogan: In This Apartment, Trust Is the Rarest Resident.
